source: National Archives Constitution transcript, Article IV Section 4
review_notes: Codex reviewed the complete section. The invasion guarantee is unconditional, while protection from domestic violence has separate legislature and executive application paths; the latter requires that the legislature cannot be convened. These are Codex labels, not independent human labels.
text:
Article. IV.
Section. 4.
The United States shall guarantee to every State in this Union a Republican Form of Government, and shall protect each of them against Invasion; and on Application of the Legislature, or of the Executive (when the Legislature cannot be convened) against domestic Violence.
